description: Image Description: The image shows a natural landscape featuring two elephants walking through a grassy savannah. The larger elephant is an adult, and the smaller one is a juvenile, possibly its calf. Both elephants have gray skin and are walking in the same direction. The adult elephant has long tusks and large ears, typical of African elephants. The background consists of green shrubs and trees scattered across the open grassy area, with a slightly hilly terrain visible in the distance. The setting suggests a wildlife habitat,
